bugs.description: Stop bit drives the line low (mux copy-paste from the start-bit branch). Exposing it requires transmitting a full frame: start + 8 data bits at 4 cycles/bit (deep counterexample, ~37 cycles).
Wrong terminal count in the baud divider (DIV+1): the baud counter exceeds its bound.

description: UART 8N1 transmitter with one-hot FSM and baud divider; asserts one-hot/legal state, baud bound, and start/stop-bit line levels.
